research.title: Anthropic Pentagon Standoff
research.summary: Trump administration banned federal use of Anthropic's Claude, but US military strikes on Iran used Anthropic AI for intelligence assessments and target identification hours after the ban was announced. Anthropic vows to challenge the designation in court.

research.title: OpenAI Pentagon Agreement
research.summary: OpenAI reached new agreement with Pentagon allowing deployment of models on classified networks. CEO Sam Altman says the agreement includes prohibitions on domestic mass surveillance and 'human responsibility for the use of force, including for autonomous weapon systems.'

research.title: YouTube's Algorithm Feeds AI Slop to Kids
research.summary: The New York Times found that after watching children's channels like CoComelon or Bluey, more than 40% of YouTube Shorts recommended contained AI-generated visuals. YouTube doesn't require AI videos for children to be labeled.

research.title: Ilya Sutskever Weighs In on Anthropic-Pentagon
research.summary: OpenAI co-founder Ilya Sutskever (now at Safe Superintelligence) posted that 'it's extremely good that Anthropic has not backed down' and that 'in the future, there will be much more challenging situations of this nature.'

research.title: ElevenLabs, creator of Suno rival Eleven Music, raises $500M at $11bn valuation
research.summary: ElevenLabs raised $500M in latest round led by Sequoia Capital, reaching $11B valuation. Major entry into AI music market to compete with Suno and Udio.

research.title: Spotify to let users 'steer the algorithm' by personalizing playlists with AI prompts
research.summary: Spotify launching new feature allowing users to personalize playlists with AI prompts - part of broader shift in personalization strategy.

research.title: Musixmatch launches Music Lens, an AI agent that transforms catalogs into actionable insights
research.summary: Musixmatch launched Music Lens - AI-powered tool built for the industry that transforms catalogs into actionable insights for publishers, labels, and creators.

research.title: Australia rejects proposal that would have exempted AI training from copyright laws
research.summary: Australia rejected AI training exemption, planning licensing regime for AI developers and rightsholders instead.

research.title: AI companies accused of 'largest domestic piracy of IP in our nation's history' at congressional hearing
research.summary: At congressional hearing led by MAGA Republican, AI companies accused of largest domestic piracy of IP in US history. Meta's Mark Zuckerberg made the call to pirate copyrighted material.

research.title: Universal Music applauds Cloudflare's move that allows content owners to charge AI companies for access
research.summary: Cloudflare now allows content owners to charge AI companies for access - Universal Music applauds. Could create new licensing marketplace.

research.title: AI song generator startups Suno and Udio hoping to join music industry
research.summary: Suno and Udio, the AI music generators that faced lawsuits from major labels, are now seeking to become part of the music industry through licensing deals and partnerships.

research.title: As AI-Generated Music Advances, Humans Still Lead in Creativity, CMU Research Finds
research.summary: Carnegie Mellon University research finds that humans still lead in creativity despite advances in AI-generated music.

research.title: Suno CEO Says AI Music Company Hits 2M Paid Subscribers, $300M ARR
research.summary: Suno announces 2 million paid subscribers and $300M annual recurring revenue - major milestone for AI music sector.

research.title: Musician Opposes Stability AI Dismissal Push in Training Lawsuit
research.summary: A musician is fighting to keep a lawsuit against Stability AI alive, arguing that the company's motion to dismiss should be denied in the AI training copyright case.

research.title: Google buys AI-music startup ProducerAI – formerly Riffusion
research.summary: Google acquires ProducerAI (formerly Riffusion), strengthening its position in the AI music generation market to compete with Suno and Udio.

research.title: Artist representatives launch 'Say No To Suno' campaign
research.summary: Artists and their representatives launch campaign against AI music generators, arguing 'AI slop dilutes the royalty pools of legitimate artists from whose music this slop is derived.'

research.title: ProducerAI: Your music creation partner, now in Google Labs
research.summary: Google launches ProducerAI in Google Labs - a new AI music creation tool that directly competes with Suno and Udio. Available to consumers via Google's ecosystem.

research.title: Who Is Building the Future of AI Music? Start With These 11 Companies
research.summary: Comprehensive overview of 11 key companies shaping AI music: Suno, Udio, Google, Apple, ElevenLabs, Meta, Amazon, TikTok (ByteDance), KLAY, and emerging startups.

research.title: 4 Must-See AI Music Video Generator Reviews: Best Tools Tested for 2026
research.summary: Roundup of AI music video generator tools - showing the expansion of AI beyond audio into visual content creation.

research.title: Google AI-Generated Audio Could Become New Ad Frontier
research.summary: Google's AI-generated audio technology being explored for advertising - brands may soon use AI music in commercials.

research.title: State legislatures considering AI music regulations
research.summary: Multiple bills being introduced at state level to regulate AI music - addressing royalty distribution, attribution, and artist rights.

research.title: Suno hires ex-Merlin CEO Jeremy Sirota as Chief Commercial Officer
research.summary: Suno, the AI music generation startup, has hired former Merlin CEO Jeremy Sirota as CCO to lead commercial strategy. Sirota will report directly to CEO Mikey Shulman.

research.title: Google launches Lyria 3 - most advanced AI music generator - in Gemini app
research.summary: Google's Lyria 3 model is now available in the Gemini app, letting users create 30-second tracks from text prompts or images. This is Google's most advanced AI music generation yet.

research.title: AI sample generator Just 4 Noise raises $1M
research.summary: Just 4 Noise, an AI sample generator that lets producers describe sounds they want and get unique royalty-free samples for their DAW, raised $1M from BADideas.fund and Sound Hub Denmark.

research.title: Apple revives Apple Music Connect as B2B promo platform
research.summary: Apple has relaunched Apple Music Connect as a B2B platform for labels and distributors, giving teams a single dashboard to manage release cycle elements.

research.title: Sony Group develops tech to track original music in AI-generated songs
research.summary: Sony Group has developed technology to identify and track original music within AI-generated songs, addressing copyright concerns in the AI music space.

research.title: Artists face steep income decline due to AI, UNESCO finds
research.summary: Music creators could see their revenues fall by 24 per cent, while those working in the audiovisual sector may lose 21 per cent of their income.

research.title: Google and Apple bring AI music creation to mainstream consumers
research.summary: Alphabet Inc.'s Google and Apple Inc. are adding music-focused generative artificial intelligence features to their core consumer apps.

research.title: The rise of AI music could be a good thing for record-label and streaming stocks
research.summary: Analysis of how AI music may impact music industry stocks and investment strategies.
